items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when I was 13, I worked with Bernard Brown, Jimmy Parker, Sam Parr, and myself. It was a fourtet.

ctx.x: Now, you said at first that you are working at 13. What was that job, what was that like?

Playing piano. I was working in a small group. We had a guitar player, a drummer, a tuba player who later played bass, and piano. We worked a little job in Pontiac. I did any number of little dances, where we had just kids. My brother, Thad, did some of the dances. A kid named James Murphy, and his brother – – James Murphy was a tenor saxophone player. The group that I did the – – when I was 13, I worked with Bernard Brown, Jimmy Parker, Sam Parr, and myself. It was a fourtet. We later worked with a bass player,…
Now, you said your father would come and get you off the bandstand. Was this just one time or a few times?
